slides.title: Decide at every step
slides.text: In a maze you have never seen, a fixed list of moves fails. An if asks a question about right now, and an if inside a loop asks it again at every step.

slides.title: If asks, when listens
slides.text: An if checks a condition now. A when block waits for an event, like a gem being picked up, and runs right then.

slides.title: Joining questions
slides.text: AND is true only when both parts are true. OR is true when at least one is. NOT flips an answer: NOT wall ahead means the way is clear.

slides.title: Any maze, one program
slides.text: This program never needs to know the maze. It checks the path at every step until Bolt reaches the goal.

slides.title: Both or one?
slides.text: A porch light turns on if it is dark AND someone is outside. Dark, but nobody there? It stays off: AND needs both parts at the same moment.

words.means: a question that is true or false
two questions joined with AND or OR
AND needs both parts true; OR needs at least one
flips true to false and false to true

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Robo Route at Conditionals & events and finish 4 levels, including one rule built with AND. Say each rule as a sentence before you build it.
